fact: The Ministry of National Education's planning, analysis and school map directorate held a validation workshop on 7 October 2025 in N'Djamena for the 2024-2025 school statistical yearbook; the document gives no release date for it.

A Ministry of Economy and Planning adviser lists school, health and justice statistical yearbooks among Chad's data sources and cites their availability as a strength of the 2024 voluntary national review; no edition or release date is given, so the document's own date is used.
